WITH expired_offers AS (
    UPDATE waitlist
    SET status = 'expired'
    WHERE status = 'offered'
      AND offer_expires_at < NOW()
    RETURNING
        id,
        flight_id,
        seat_class
),
released_seats AS (
    UPDATE seat_classes sc
    SET available_seats = available_seats + 1
    FROM expired_offers eo
    WHERE sc.flight_id = eo.flight_id
      AND sc.class = eo.seat_class
    RETURNING
        sc.flight_id,
        sc.class,
        sc.available_seats
)
SELECT
    eo.id AS waitlist_id,
    eo.flight_id,
    eo.seat_class,
    rs.available_seats
FROM expired_offers eo
JOIN released_seats rs
    ON rs.flight_id = eo.flight_id
   AND rs.class = eo.seat_class;

WITH next_waitlist AS (
    SELECT
        w.id,
        w.flight_id,
        w.passenger_id,
        w.seat_class
    FROM waitlist w
    JOIN seat_classes sc
      ON sc.flight_id = w.flight_id
     AND sc.class = w.seat_class
    WHERE w.status = 'waiting'
      AND sc.available_seats > 0
    ORDER BY w.joined_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),
reserve_seat AS (
    UPDATE seat_classes sc
    SET available_seats = sc.available_seats - 1
    FROM next_waitlist nw
    WHERE sc.flight_id = nw.flight_id
      AND sc.class = nw.seat_class
      AND sc.available_seats > 0
    RETURNING sc.flight_id, sc.class
)
UPDATE waitlist w
SET
    status = 'offered',
    offered_at = NOW(),
    offer_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '15 minutes'
FROM next_waitlist nw
JOIN reserve_seat rs
  ON rs.flight_id = nw.flight_id
 AND rs.class = nw.seat_class
WHERE w.id = nw.id
RETURNING
    w.id AS waitlist_id,
    w.flight_id,
    w.passenger_id,
    w.seat_class,
    w.status,
    w.offered_at,
    w.offer_expires_at;
